nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of the contract owner; written by constructors and ownership transfer/renounce functions and read by the onlyOwner modifier.
BasicToken.balances: mapping(address => uint256) of token balances; mutated in transfer, transferFrom and SMCT._transfer.
BasicToken.totalSupply_: total number of tokens in existence; set in the SMCT constructor and read by totalSupply().
StandardToken.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of allowances; mutated by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
SMCT.name constant string token name 'Smart Momentum Chain Token'.
SMCT.symbol constant string token symbol 'SMCT'.
SMCT.decimals constant uint8 with value 4, used to scale the initial supply.
SMCT.INITIAL_SUPPLY constant = 1000000000 * 10**decimals, the amount minted in the constructor.
SMCT.touched mapping(address => bool) declared but never read or written in the provided code.
Ownable() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function body.
transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner function that rejects address(0) and reassigns owner.
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function that sets owner to address(0).
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): multiplication with overflow assert.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): integer division; reverts automatically on b == 0.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): subtraction guarded by assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): addition guarded by assert(c >= a).
BasicToken.totalSupply(): view returning totalSupply_.
BasicToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): public token transfer from msg.sender using SafeMath sub/add.
BasicToken.balanceOf(address _owner): view returning balances[_owner].
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): allowance-based transfer mutating balances and allowed.
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] (classic approval race).
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender): view returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue): additive allowance update via SafeMath.add.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue): subtractive allowance update with SafeMath.sub.
SMCT() constructor: sets totalSupply_ and mints INITIAL_SUPPLY to msg.sender.
SMCT._transfer(address _from, address _to, uint _value): internal balance update with manual overflow require checks and SafeMath sub/add.
SMCT.safeWithdrawal(uint _value): onlyOwner function performing owner.transfer of contract balance or _value.
msg.sender as used by the Ownable constructor and onlyOwner modifier to set/compare the owner.
msg.sender as used as token holder/spender in BasicToken.transfer and StandardToken approve/increase/decrease/transferFrom.
msg.sender as the recipient of INITIAL_SUPPLY in the SMCT constructor.
owner.transfer(address(this).balance) or owner.transfer(_value): external ETH call from safeWithdrawal to the owner address.
Raw uint256 subtraction (a - b) inside SafeMath.sub; guarded only by assert.
Raw uint256 addition (a + b) inside SafeMath.add; guarded only by assert.
Raw uint256 multiplication (a * b) inside SafeMath.mul; overflow guarded by assert(c / a == b).
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) balance decrement inside BasicToken.transfer.
balances[_to].add(_value) balance increment inside BasicToken.transfer.
balances[_from].sub(_value) balance decrement inside transferFrom.
balances[_to].add(_value) balance increment inside transferFrom.
allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) allowance decrement inside transferFrom.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) allowance increment inside increaseApproval.
oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) allowance decrement inside decreaseApproval.
balances[_from].sub(_value) balance decrement inside SMCT._transfer.
balances[_to].add(_value) balance increment inside SMCT._transfer.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership: the new owner address, checked against address(0).
Parameter _to of BasicToken.transfer: recipient address, checked against address(0).
Parameter _value of BasicToken.transfer: amount to transfer, checked against the sender balance.
Parameter _owner of BasicToken.balanceOf: address whose balance is queried.
Parameter _from of StandardToken.transferFrom: source address whose balance and allowance are debited.
Parameter _to of StandardToken.transferFrom: recipient address.
Parameter _value of StandardToken.transferFrom: amount transferred.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.approve: address granted the allowance.
Parameter _value of StandardToken.approve: allowance amount written directly.
Parameter _owner of StandardToken.allowance: owner side of the queried allowance.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.allowance: spender side of the queried allowance.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.increaseApproval.
Parameter _addedValue of StandardToken.increaseApproval: added to the existing allowance.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.decreaseApproval.
Parameter _subtractedValue of StandardToken.decreaseApproval: subtracted from the existing allowance.
Local oldValue in decreaseApproval caching allowed[msg.sender][_spender] before branch comparison.
Parameter _from of SMCT._transfer: source address debited.
Parameter _to of SMCT._transfer: recipient address credited.
Parameter _value of SMCT._transfer: amount moved between balances.
Parameter _value of SMCT.safeWithdrawal: chosen amount for owner.transfer, or 0 meaning full balance.
Parameter a shared by SafeMath.mul/div/sub/add: first operand.
Parameter b shared by SafeMath.mul/div/sub/add: second operand.
Local c in SafeMath.mul holding the multiplication result checked by assert.

edges.reason: newOwner is written into the owner state variable by transferOwnership.
_to recipient address flows into BasicToken.transfer.
_value amount flows into BasicToken.transfer.
_owner is used as the mapping key in BasicToken.balanceOf.
_from source address flows into StandardToken.transferFrom.
_to recipient address flows into StandardToken.transferFrom.
_value amount flows into StandardToken.transferFrom.
_spender is used as the allowance key in approve.
_value is written directly as the allowance in approve.
_owner is the first key in the allowance lookup.
_spender is the second key in the allowance lookup.
_spender indexes the allowance updated by increaseApproval.
_addedValue is added to the allowance in increaseApproval.
_spender indexes the allowance updated by decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is subtracted from the allowance in decreaseApproval.
oldValue local is read in the decreaseApproval branch comparison.
_from is debited inside SMCT._transfer.
_to is credited inside SMCT._transfer.
_value is moved between balances inside SMCT._transfer.
_value selects the transfer amount in safeWithdrawal.
Operand a is multiplied in SafeMath.mul.
Operand b is multiplied in SafeMath.mul.
Local c receives and returns the product in SafeMath.mul.
Operand a is the dividend in SafeMath.div.
Operand b is the divisor in SafeMath.div.
Operand a is the minuend in SafeMath.sub.
Operand b is the subtrahend in SafeMath.sub.
Operand a is the first addend in SafeMath.add.
Operand b is the second addend in SafeMath.add.
The Ownable constructor takes owner directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner authorizes execution by comparing msg.sender to owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts safeWithdrawal to msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender determines which balance is debited in BasicToken.transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked and debited in transferFrom.
approve writes the allowance entry keyed by msg.sender.
increaseApproval mutates the allowance entry keyed by msg.sender.
decreaseApproval mutates the allowance entry keyed by msg.sender.
The SMCT constructor mints INITIAL_SUPPLY to the untrusted msg.sender.
SafeMath.mul performs the raw multiplication a * b with an assert overflow check.
SafeMath.sub performs the raw subtraction a - b guarded only by assert.
SafeMath.add performs the raw addition a + b guarded only by assert.
BasicToken.transfer subtracts _value from balances[msg.sender].
BasicToken.transfer adds _value to balances[_to].
transferFrom subtracts _value from balances[_from].
transferFrom adds _value to balances[_to].
transferFrom subtracts _value from the caller allowance.
increaseApproval adds _addedValue to the existing allowance.
decreaseApproval subtracts _subtractedValue from the existing allowance.
SMCT._transfer subtracts _value from balances[_from].
SMCT._transfer adds _value to balances[_to].
The Ownable constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for the require check.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner.
renounceOwnership clears the owner state variable to address(0).
totalSupply() returns the totalSupply_ state variable.
BasicToken.transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping of _from and _to.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping entry for msg.sender.
approve writes the allowed mapping entry.
allowance reads the allowed mapping entry.
increaseApproval updates the allowed mapping entry.
decreaseApproval updates the allowed mapping entry.
The SMCT constructor mints the initial balance into the balances mapping.
The SMCT constructor sets totalSupply_ to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
The SMCT constructor reads the INITIAL_SUPPLY constant.
SMCT._transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
BasicToken.transfer invokes SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
BasicToken.transfer invokes SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.sub for balances and allowance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
increaseApproval invokes SafeMath.add on the allowance.
decreaseApproval invokes SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
SMCT._transfer invokes SafeMath.sub for balances[_from].
SMCT._transfer invokes SafeMath.add for balances[_to].
safeWithdrawal is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier before any transfer.
safeWithdrawal performs an external ETH transfer (owner.transfer), an outbound call that can interact with a contract owner.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a function-scoped parameter whose only role is to be validated and stored as owner by transferOwnership.
_to is a local-scope recipient parameter used only inside BasicToken.transfer.
_value is a local-scope amount parameter used only inside BasicToken.transfer.
_owner is a lookup key parameter used only inside balanceOf.
_from is a transfer-source parameter used only inside transferFrom.
_to is a recipient parameter used only inside transferFrom.
_value is an amount parameter used only inside transferFrom.
_spender is an allowance-key parameter used only inside approve.
_value is the allowance amount parameter written only inside approve.
_owner is a query-key parameter used only inside allowance.
_spender is a query-key parameter used only inside allowance.
_spender is an allowance-key parameter used only inside increaseApproval.
_addedValue is a delta parameter added only by increaseApproval.
_spender is an allowance-key parameter used only inside decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is a delta parameter subtracted only by decreaseApproval.
oldValue is a temporary cache of the allowance living only inside decreaseApproval.
_from is the debited source parameter of the internal SMCT._transfer helper.
_to is the credited recipient parameter of the internal SMCT._transfer helper.
_value is the amount parameter of the internal SMCT._transfer helper.
_value selects the withdrawal amount and exists only inside the owner-gated safeWithdrawal.
a is a shared SafeMath operand consumed by the arithmetic helper functions such as mul.
b is a shared SafeMath operand consumed by the arithmetic helper functions such as mul.
c is a temporary result variable created and returned only inside SafeMath.mul.
